race.comment: BEAUTIFUL YOU (11) led on debut at Wyong and was only caught on the post, beaten in a photo finish over 1200m. She comes back to country level now and maps to be up front from the outset once again. The rise in trip shouldn't be an issue and she can go one better. RING OF FIRE (3) finished nicely first-up at Goulburn and looks to be inching towards a maiden win. McDougall's booking signals the stables intent. Can get get the job done this time. WAVES OF WISDOM (5) won't be far away on the back of a strong debut effort. BALMAIN WARRIOR (1) faded out of contention in a tougher race first-up but he should be better for that effort off a lengthy absence. Expecting a better run this time.
